text:
.@bot is just so damn good.

I've got multiple Google Workspace accounts that are authenticated and being used. 

It just works.

Also works perfectly across both my Mac and my iPhone.

I have two bots right now:

1. Chief of Staff - "R2" knows everything about me and runs my calendars, email, tasks

2. CRM - "Lando" Runs my outbound sales funnel and coordinates with R2.
